Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Parson Rustic Buffet Sideboard Storage Cabinet 56"W, Oak Wood
Colors: Buffet
Materials: Hardwood
This beautiful buffet features sturdy, durable construction and timeless oak finish. Its transitional style has just the right touches of traditional and rustic, while concealed ball-bearing glides support smooth, self-closing drawers. 56"W x 18"D x 32"H Hardwood frame and drawers with oak veneer Self-closing drawers move smoothly, thanks to concealed ball-bearing extension glides Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Assembly is required. Wipe with soft dry cloth.
